registered: after downloading DefiLlama fees / TVL (scripts/v99/get_defillama_fees.py), BEFORE computing any signal or return
why: fundamentals were never used cross-sectionally here (grep: protocol fees 0, value factor 0; earlier DefiLlama use was market-wide only: stablecoins, DEX volume, total TVL). Equities: earnings momentum / post-earnings drift; crypto: usage (fees paid by users) that grows faster than price should be underpriced by attention-driven traders
data: DefiLlama daily fees (protocol for DeFi tokens, chain for L1 / L2 tokens) and TVL, fixed mapping in get_defillama_fees.py; each daily value used with a 1-day lag (only days before the rebalance day). Caveat: DefiLlama back-fills new adapters, so early history is not strictly point in time
universe: R14 loader coins with the needed series: >= 90 days of fees (A, B) or TVL (C) before the rebalance and positive 28-day sums; at least 8 eligible coins, else no position

trials.A fee momentum: g = log(fees of the last 28 days / fees of the 28 days before); long the top third, short the bottom third, equal weight, dollar neutral
trials.B fees vs price: g minus log(price change over the same 28 days): usage growing faster than price -> long
trials.C TVL vs price: log(TVL change over 28 days) minus log(price change over 28 days) -> long the top third, short the bottom third

rebalance_costs: weekly on Monday 00:00 UTC, 8 bp per side + Binance funding (R14 sleeve code)
judge: as a 10th v9.8 sleeve: book >= 3.211 + 0.05 and no period (2022 / 2023-24 / 2025-26) lower
